description: Calculate chicken/quail flock sizing, incubation guidelines, weekly feed, spaces, and costs for any of the 310 avian breeds.

eggUnit.description: Unit of target eggs: "chicken" or "quail". Defaults to "chicken".

experience.description: Owner poultry experience level: "beginner", "some", or "experienced". Defaults to "beginner".

householdSize.description: Household size (range 1-50, used when mode="household"). Defaults to 4.

meatBirdsPerMonth.description: Optional meat birds to raise/process per month

mode.description: Mode to size by: "household" (by people size) or "target" (by targeted eggs per week). Defaults to "target" if positive targetEggs is given, otherwise "household".

quailShare.description: Quail percentage of the flock: 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.50 for 50%). Defaults to 0.50.

spaceAvailableSqFt.description: Optional available square feet to validate if flock plan fits

targetEggs.description: Target eggs per week (used when mode="target").

name: plan_flock
